label: D2: reached S2 after a rewarded previous trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO) and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds 100% of mass; never fires at D2 after an unrewarded trial). Within that it is mainly about reaching S2 (80% of mass, rate 0.34 vs 0.03 for S1). All variables are observed at D2. Magnitude: the strongest activations (near max) are rare transitions a1->S2 after a reward, typically in S1-good blocks with recent rare-S2 history; common a2->S2 activations are mostly tiny (~0.02-0.1 of max). Activity is also modulated by model value (rate 0.34 in the top value bin) and declines late in the episode (trials 70+). Missed mass (~20%) is weak firing on S1 D2 steps after reward. Precision is limited (~0.52): many rewarded-history S2 D2 steps are silent, so the feature is a sparse, magnitude-graded S2-after-reward signal rather than a clean binary detector. Adding value>7.7 or ep_trial<70 raises F1 to ~0.75 but loses mass recall, so the simpler predicate was recorded.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D2: a1 S2 r, a2 S2 r, a1 S1 r) and this trial (D2: a2 S2, a1 S2); timing cues that raise it most: rel=-3, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0, phase=D2 & ep_dec=1.
